hook.name: MaybeHook
hook.description: A probabilistic Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/MAYBE pool that implements "maybification": when a user opts in via hookData on an ETH→MAYBE exactIn swap, the MAYBE output is burned and Chainlink VRF randomness is used to determine whether the user wins a multiplied MAYBE payout (based on a configurable probability in basis points) or loses. LP fees are donated as MAYBE to liquidity providers.
